Citi placed ADI on 30-day positive catalyst watch list with 'Buy' rating and $400 PT, expecting April/July quarter results to exceed estimates due to higher analog chip pricing. Feb 2026 guidance: Q2 revenue ~$3.5B and EPS ~$2.19. AI and data center exposure ~20% of revenue. S&P Global upgraded issuer credit rating to 'A' from 'A-' on Apr 17, 2026.
